items.title: Jensen Huang Is Back. Nvidia’s (NVDA) Bull Case Remains
items.summary: Jensen Huang is back at the helm, and Nvidia’s (NVDA) bull case remains in play. Nvidia shares surged 31.5% on November 23 after news of Jensen Huang’s reinstatement, underscoring how closely investor confidence in the company is tied to its co-founder. While near-term volatility is likely to persist, I remain decisively Bullish over the long term. Nvidia makes the chips, networking gear, and software powering the artificial intelligence (AI) boom, and its earnings story is strong enough to ride

items.title: What Broadcom Stock's Google Chip Order Cut Means For Shareholders
items.summary: Reports in late November indicated that Alphabet plans to trim 2027 shipments of Broadcom designed TPU AI chips by about 20%, which came alongside wider concern about whether heavy AI data center spending will generate adequate returns. The development highlights how Broadcom’s AI semiconductor outlook depends on a concentrated group of hyperscale buyers, leaving its custom chip pipeline sensitive to even incremental changes in orders from one key client. items.title: Qualcomm Is Betting Big on a $5 Billion Opportunity. Here’s What It Could Mean for the Stock
items.summary: Handsets are shrinking, the stock just whipsawed double digits, and Wall Street analysts mostly shrug. Yet one fast-growing business, limited by supply instead of demand, may be quietly rewriting Qualcomm's story. Can it outrun the risks hiding in its customer list?
